description: Unit test class for the Basket entity in the eShopWeb application, specifically testing the AddItem method and related behaviors.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: A test class containing multiple unit tests for the Basket class's AddItem method and related behaviors.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an item to the basket when the item is not already present adds it correctly.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding the same item again increments its quantity.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures the original unit price is retained if the same item is added with a different price.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Checks that adding an item without specifying quantity defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Verifies that adding an item with a negative quantity throws an exception.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Checks that attempting to modify item quantity to a negative number throws an exception.
